zh.text: 服务端运行时，启动器创建账号改走服务端进程内写入：不勾选「授予 GM 权限」会真正创建普通玩家账号，不再在首次登录时被服务端自动补建成 GM；勾选后才获得管理权限。
补齐账号管理、启动器更新、市场、热重载、模组与设置等 49 条遗漏的多语言文案，并新增源码 AST 门禁，防止界面新增中文却忘记同步到七种外语。
界面语言目录改为按当前语言懒加载：React 首屏主包从约 3.38 MB 降到约 1.44 MB，启动解析和初始内存占用明显下降，切换语言时只加载目标语言并缓存。
账号页的 5 秒在线刷新改用轻量 accounts:online 通道，只读取 host 写出的在线角色 ID 快照，不再反复启动 Node 和读取完整账号库。
物品市场改属性支持还原：弹窗会把与服务端原厂值（SDE）不一致的属性标出来（原值加删除线排在现值前面），行尾一个还原图标、底部整件还原；还原走原来的保存路径，照旧先留快照再热重载。
修好「主服务器已经停了、但上一轮会话还留在盘上」时改物品属性会僵住的问题：以前每次保存要等满 5 分钟热重载超时（看着就是点了没反应，随后再存同样的值又回「没有改动」），现在改成先用短握手确认有没有服务端接收，没有就 5 秒内返回并提示「改动已写盘、下次启动生效」。

en.text: When the server is running, launcher-created accounts are now written inside the server process. Clearing "Grant GM" creates a real player account instead of one that is silently promoted to GM on first login; checking it grants staff permissions.

Filled in 49 missing localized strings across account management, launcher updates, market, hot reload, mods and settings, and added a source AST gate so UI text cannot ship without matching all seven foreign catalogs.

Locale catalogs are now loaded on demand. The React startup bundle dropped from about 3.38 MB to 1.44 MB, cutting initial parsing and memory use; switching languages loads and caches only the selected catalog.

The account page now refreshes online status through the lightweight accounts:online channel every five seconds. It only reads the online character ID snapshot written by the host instead of starting Node and reading the entire account database again.

Market attribute editing now supports restoring original values: the dialog marks attributes that differ from the server's SDE baseline (original value struck through before the current value), offers a per-row restore action and a restore-all action, and uses the existing save path so snapshots and hot reload still apply.

Fixed attribute saves hanging when the main server had stopped but a stale session file remained. Previously each save waited the full five-minute hot-reload timeout, looking like a no-op until a second identical save reported "no changes"; a short handshake now returns within five seconds with the accurate "written to disk, effective on next start" result.
